sections.content:
Useful vocabulary and phrases when discussing studying abroad:

• hacer un intercambio (to do an exchange)
• irse de Erasmus (in Europe, to study abroad with the Erasmus grant)
• convalidar asignaturas (to validate / transfer credits)
• alojamiento para estudiantes (student housing)

sections.title: Study Abroad Phrases
rows: Meg se va de intercambio el próximo curso.

items.spanish: Estudiar en el extranjero te abre la mente a nuevas culturas.
items.english: Studying abroad opens your mind to new cultures.
